newsitem.title: UK: C&W discusses possible Sprint bid - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: C&W discusses possible Sprint bid - WSJ.

text.p: Cable and Wireless Plc has held talks with Sprint Corp shareholder France Telecom on a possible C&W bid for Sprint, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday.
No spokesman at Cable and Wireless was immediately available for comment.

The newspaper report, sourced to people familiar with the talks, said the bid would be for the 80 percent of U.S. telecom firm Sprint which is not already owned by France Telecom and Germany's Deutsche Telekom, each of whom have 10 percent, and could be for more than $15 billion.

The Journal said C&W had yet to make a formal offer to Sprint and said many financial, managerial and regulatory details would have to be worked out before an approach could be made. C&W intends to seek Deutsche Telekom's approval at a later date, it added.
If such a move materialised, it would create a global telecoms giant spanning the U.S., Europe and Asia.
